core.title: Multi-scale physics-informed reinforcement learning method for bearing fault diagnosis under data scarcity
core.abstract: Identifying mechanical faults is crucial for maintaining stability in industrial systems. However, the lack of labeled fault data significantly undermines the accuracy and generalization of diagnostic methods in practical applications. To address this issue, this paper presents a novel multi-scale physics-informed neural network with enhanced reinforcement learning (MPINN-ERL) for bearing fault diagnosis under data scarcity. First, a multi-scale convolutional bi-directional gated recurrent unit with physics-inspired residual regularization module is developed to effectively integrate physics-inspired dynamic residual regularization into the system, thereby improving the stability of diagnostic performance. Furthermore, a conditional channel-spatial Wasserstein generative adversarial network is designed to generate augmented fault samples for alleviating the limited-sample problem. Finally, a novel loss function and an ERL algorithm are introduced to dynamically adjust the weight of physics-inspired dynamic residual regularization, thereby improving the model’s diagnostic stability when labeled data are scarce. Experimental results on the evaluated bearing fault datasets show that the proposed method achieves competitive diagnostic accuracy. Compared with several representative state-of-the-art deep learning methods, MPINN-ERL also exhibits relatively stable diagnostic performance.
core.summary: 轴承故障标注不足会削弱诊断准确性与泛化能力。本文提出MPINN-ERL，将多尺度卷积、双向门控循环单元与物理启发残差正则化结合，通过条件生成对抗网络扩充故障样本，再用增强强化学习动态调节正则项权重。[摘要]报告其诊断准确性具有竞争力、表现相对稳定，但未给出具体数值或实验设置。本导读仅依据摘要，适合关注小样本智能运维的读者，不足以确认其优势幅度与适用边界。

raw_metadata.title_zh: 数据稀缺条件下轴承故障诊断的多尺度物理信息强化学习方法
raw_metadata.recommendation: 建议作为小样本轴承智能诊断的方法型候选重点阅读，尤其关注样本增强与正则权重动态调节如何协同；摘要尚不足以支持直接复现或工程采用。[摘要]

deep_read.problem: 论文针对轴承故障诊断中标注样本不足的问题，摘要指出“lack of labeled fault data”会损害诊断准确性与泛化能力。[摘要]其研究目标不仅是提高识别准确性，还包括维持稀缺标注条件下的诊断稳定性；摘要未说明样本稀缺的具体程度。
deep_read.method: 方法采用带物理启发残差正则化的多尺度卷积与双向门控循环单元，并以条件通道—空间Wasserstein生成对抗网络扩充故障样本。随后引入新损失函数和增强强化学习算法，动态调整残差正则项权重。[摘要]各模块结构及训练流程尚未披露。
deep_read.innovation: 摘要将组合方法称为“novel”，并提出新的损失函数与增强强化学习算法。[摘要]解读：值得核查的创新点在于让物理启发正则约束的强度动态变化，而非仅叠加诊断与生成模块；但没有公式及相关工作比较，无法确认其独创程度。
deep_read.findings: 实验结论限于所评估的轴承故障数据集：准确性达到“competitive diagnostic accuracy”，相较若干代表性先进深度学习方法，诊断表现相对稳定。[摘要]这些是定性报告，不能改写为全面领先，也无法据此判断增益大小或统计显著性。
deep_read.limitations: 摘要没有提供数据集名称、标注样本量、评价指标数值、对比方法清单及消融结果，因此难以分离各模块贡献。[摘要]解读：这些属于当前资料的证据缺口，并不等于论文未开展相关实验；物理残差的依据及生成样本可信度也需全文核验。
deep_read.connection: 解读：该研究直接对应智能运维中的少标注故障识别，可为可靠性研究提供状态诊断层面的候选方法，但摘要未涉及寿命预测、失效概率或结构设计优化。[摘要]其“physics-inspired”表述也不足以证明模型严格满足明确的机械控制方程。
deep_read.next_steps: 建议：获取全文后优先核查残差定义、强化学习的状态与奖励、生成数据的训练边界，并检查不同标注比例下的消融和重复实验。若迁移到自有设备，可分别验证增强模块与动态权重机制的贡献；这些是后续研究建议，并非作者已报告的结果。

article.lead: 轴承故障诊断面临的难点，不只是识别故障，还包括标注数据稀缺时能否保持可靠表现。这项研究将物理启发正则化、生成式数据增强与强化学习结合，探索兼顾诊断准确性与稳定性的方法。

sections.title: 标注不足，影响的不只是诊断准确率
paragraphs: 机械故障识别关系到工业系统的稳定运行，但实际应用中的故障标注数据不足，会削弱诊断方法的准确性与泛化能力。本文针对这一问题提出MPINN-ERL，即结合增强强化学习的多尺度物理信息神经网络，研究对象是数据稀缺条件下的轴承故障诊断。

sections.title: 把残差约束、样本增强与权重调节结合起来
paragraphs: 诊断模型采用多尺度卷积与双向门控循环单元，并加入物理启发残差正则化模块，将动态残差正则化融入系统。这里应保留“物理启发”的限定：摘要没有给出残差的具体公式，也未说明它对应哪些轴承动力学关系，不能据此将其理解为完整物理方程的直接求解。
针对样本不足，研究设计了条件通道—空间Wasserstein生成对抗网络，用于生成增强故障样本。此外，作者引入损失函数与增强强化学习算法，动态调整物理启发动态残差正则化的权重。方法设计因此同时涉及数据增强与约束权重调节，而不只是增加网络结构。

sections.title: 摘要报告了有竞争力的准确性与相对稳定性
paragraphs: 摘要报告，在所评估的轴承故障数据集上，MPINN-ERL取得了有竞争力的诊断准确性；与若干具有代表性的先进深度学习方法相比，其诊断表现也相对稳定。**这一结论限于已评估的数据集与比较范围**，摘要没有提供具体准确率、提升幅度或稳定性指标，因此不宜进一步写成全面领先或已验证的工业部署效果。

sections.title: 样本规模、比较条件与验证边界仍待查阅
paragraphs: 仅凭摘要，尚无法判断数据集名称、真实标注样本数量、故障类别、训练测试划分，以及生成增强样本的数量和质量。增强样本不能直接视为新增的独立实测样本。比较方法的具体名单、调参条件、稳定性的衡量方式，以及是否包含跨工况或现场验证，也需要进一步查阅正文；这些属于摘要未报告的信息，并不意味着论文没有开展相关工作。

sections.title: 阅读启发：关注物理约束如何参与诊断
paragraphs: 阅读启发：对智能运维读者，这项工作的关注点不仅是故障样本如何扩充，还在于物理启发约束如何进入模型，以及其权重为何需要动态调整。进一步阅读时，可重点核对残差的物理含义、强化学习的调节机制，以及各组成部分对最终表现的贡献证据，再判断这一组合是否适用于自身的数据稀缺场景。

core.title: Machine-learning ultrasonic detection of fatigue cracks: a physics-based simulation study
core.abstract: Fatigue cracks in microtextured titanium alloys are hard to find by ultrasound. Backscatter from alpha colonies, modulated by microtextured regions, mimics a small flaw, and crack faces held in contact by residual stress reflect far less energy than their area suggests. This paper is a simulation study. It builds a forward model of pulse-echo inspection whose constants are those of mill-annealed Ti-6Al-4V, verified against closed-form solutions on 15 quantities, and uses it to characterise what a learned detector can and cannot deliver under that model. The model solves a bilinear contact law at the crack interface, coupling the linear and nonlinear scattering paths. The detector reads the drive and second-harmonic bands through a small dilated residual encoder trained on simulated records only, and converts the score into a decision by split conformal calibration, whose false-call guarantee holds under exchangeability and is not claimed under distribution shift. On simulated test specimens with crack half-lengths from 0.05 to 1.0 mm, the encoder calls 73 of 84 low-contact cracks with no false call on 180 defect-free specimens (95% upper bound 0.017), and its fitted half-length at 90% detection is 0.138 mm (bootstrap interval 0.088–0.181 mm). A second-harmonic peak with no learning has the highest part-level area under the curve, the four leading methods are not separable on that measure, and an input ablation shows that an encoder reading the second-harmonic envelope alone matches or exceeds the full model, so the harmonic band carries the performance; over five training seeds the low-contact detection count spans 73 to 82 of 84. The encoder adds decision efficiency at the operating point, nine additional low-contact detections against one lost relative to the harmonic peak (paired test p = 0.02 ), not information absent from the measurement. Detection is confined to contact fractions between 0.05 and 0.30. The decision layer alone is then applied, as a methodological case study, to measured guided-wave data from an aluminium plate cycled to 100,000 cycles, where the second-harmonic channel gives 4 false calls in 370 angle tests and the drive band 9. No experimental validation on Ti-6Al-4V or on any other titanium alloy is presented, the only measured data are aluminium, and no qualification is claimed.

core.title: How the Classical Baseline Shapes Machine-Learning Speed Claims in Topology Optimization: code and data
core.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
core.abstract: Audit records, analysis and re-test scripts, run summaries, figure data and Online Resources 1-6 for the paper 'How the Classical Baseline Shapes Machine-Learning Speed Claims in Topology Optimization' (arXiv:2610.16051). core.title: Functional Tree Forest: A Hybrid Bagging-Boosting Ensemble Machine Learning Approach for Battery Fault Diagnosis in Electric Vehicles
core.abstract: Accurate battery fault detection and diagnosis (FDD) is essential for ensuring the safety, health monitoring, and operational performance of electric vehicles (EVs). Yet, existing research still suffers from issues such as limited classification accuracy due to non-linear feature interactions and insufficient interpretability. To address these limitations, this study proposes the Functional Tree Forest (FTF), a hybrid Bagging-Boosting ensemble machine learning approach that combines multiple functional trees with LogitBoost-based modeling, while preserving model explainability. Unlike conventional decision trees that rely solely on axis-aligned univariate attribute splits, the FTF architecture dynamically integrates multivariate linear regression functions at both internal nodes and terminal leaf nodes, capturing complex feature interactions. The proposed method was evaluated on five publicly available EV battery fault datasets. The experimental results showed that FTF achieved top numerical accuracy across 13 baseline machine learning approaches, including linear models, conventional tree-based classifiers, ensembles, and network-based topologies. Furthermore, when compared with results directly given in the state-of-the-art studies utilizing identical datasets under varying experimental protocols, FTF yielded competitive performance relative to previously reported literature, although the magnitude of the performance difference varied across datasets.

core.title: Comparative Study of Machine Learning Algorithms for Fault Diagnosis in PV Systems Specifically Under Low Irradiance Conditions
core.abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) systems continue to expand worldwide, and reliable fault diagnosis has become increasingly important for ensuring safe and stable operation. Although machine-learning-based fault diagnosis has been widely investigated, most previous studies have focused on high-irradiance environments. In contrast, the effectiveness of fault diagnosis under low-irradiance conditions remains insufficiently explored. This study investigates the applicability of machine learning algorithms for diagnosing partial-shading faults in PV systems operating under low-irradiance conditions. An outdoor experimental PV system was used to simulate fault conditions, and current-voltage (I-V) characteristics were collected under various operating conditions. Prior to model development, outlier detection and data preprocessing were performed to improve data quality. Several supervised machine learning algorithms were trained and evaluated using commonly adopted classification metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The results indicate that fault diagnosis becomes more challenging under low-irradiance conditions because the differences between normal and faulty operating states become less distinct. Consequently, the performance of all evaluated algorithms tended to decrease compared with that observed under conventional irradiance conditions. Nevertheless, reliable fault detection remained feasible. Among the investigated methods, ensemble learning approaches demonstrated superior and more robust performance than conventional classification algorithms. These findings confirm the feasibility of machine-learning-based fault diagnosis for PV systems operating under low-irradiance conditions and highlight the potential of ensemble learning techniques for practical fault detection in regions with limited solar irradiance.

core.title: Generative design and computational characterization of pyrazoline-based EGFR kinase inhibitor candidates.
core.abstract: The epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) is an established therapeutic target in breast, colorectal, and non-small cell lung cancers, and pyrazoline-containing scaffolds have been repeatedly reported as EGFR inhibitors. This study combined generative machine learning with physics-based modelling to design and computationally characterize novel pyrazoline analogues targeting the EGFR kinase ATP-binding site. A curated set of 50 experimentally validated pyrazoline-based EGFR inhibitors, compiled from ChEMBL and the primary literature, was used to seed the Mol2Mol model in REINVENT4, generating a large library of structurally related analogues. The library was sequentially filtered according to Tanimoto similarity to the seed actives (≥0.6), predicted physicochemical, pharmacokinetic, and toxicity properties, synthetic accessibility (SA score <6), and molecular docking against the EGFR kinase domain (PDB 5U8L), using a self-docking validated protocol (redocking RMSD 1.342 Å). Five candidates, designated PyEG1-PyEG5, achieved docking scores between -9.5 and -10.6 kcal/mol, better than the redocked native ligand (-9.2 kcal/mol). All five complexes remained stable during 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations, with backbone RMSD ≤ 0.27 nm, average ligand RMSD ≤ 0.18 nm, and radii of gyration close to those of the reference complex. MM-GBSA end-point calculations yielded binding free energies of -9.9 to -37.5 kcal/mol, with PyEG5 (-37.5 ± 2.5 kcal/mol) approaching the reference ligand value (-37.6 ± 6.0 kcal/mol). Density functional theory calculations (B3LYP/6-31G(d)) indicated HOMO-LUMO gaps of 5.89-6.65 eV, with PyEG2 and PyEG5 predicted to be the most reactive and PyEG3 the most kinetically stable. Structure-activity analysis based on the predicted binding modes suggests that hinge-directed hydrogen bonding to Met793 and π-π stacking with Phe856 are the principal determinants of predicted affinity, modulated by substituent electronics and steric bulk at the R, R1, and R2 positions. These findings are entirely computational; PyEG1-PyEG5 should be considered prioritized synthetic targets, and their activity requires confirmation through biochemical kinase assays and cell-based testing.

papers.title: Multi-scale physics-informed reinforcement learning method for bearing fault diagnosis under data scarcity
papers.abstract: Identifying mechanical faults is crucial for maintaining stability in industrial systems. However, the lack of labeled fault data significantly undermines the accuracy and generalization of diagnostic methods in practical applications. To address this issue, this paper presents a novel multi-scale physics-informed neural network with enhanced reinforcement learning (MPINN-ERL) for bearing fault diagnosis under data scarcity. First, a multi-scale convolutional bi-directional gated recurrent unit with physics-inspired residual regularization module is developed to effectively integrate physics-inspired dynamic residual regularization into the system, thereby improving the stability of diagnostic performance. Furthermore, a conditional channel-spatial Wasserstein generative adversarial network is designed to generate augmented fault samples for alleviating the limited-sample problem. Finally, a novel loss function and an ERL algorithm are introduced to dynamically adjust the weight of physics-inspired dynamic residual regularization, thereby improving the model’s diagnostic stability when labeled data are scarce. Experimental results on the evaluated bearing fault datasets show that the proposed method achieves competitive diagnostic accuracy. Compared with several representative state-of-the-art deep learning methods, MPINN-ERL also exhibits relatively stable diagnostic performance.
papers.summary: 轴承故障标注不足会削弱诊断准确性与泛化能力。本文提出MPINN-ERL，将多尺度卷积、双向门控循环单元与物理启发残差正则化结合，通过条件生成对抗网络扩充故障样本，再用增强强化学习动态调节正则项权重。[摘要]报告其诊断准确性具有竞争力、表现相对稳定，但未给出具体数值或实验设置。本导读仅依据摘要，适合关注小样本智能运维的读者，不足以确认其优势幅度与适用边界。

raw_metadata.title_zh: 数据稀缺条件下轴承故障诊断的多尺度物理信息强化学习方法
raw_metadata.recommendation: 建议作为小样本轴承智能诊断的方法型候选重点阅读，尤其关注样本增强与正则权重动态调节如何协同；摘要尚不足以支持直接复现或工程采用。[摘要]

deep_read.problem: 论文针对轴承故障诊断中标注样本不足的问题，摘要指出“lack of labeled fault data”会损害诊断准确性与泛化能力。[摘要]其研究目标不仅是提高识别准确性，还包括维持稀缺标注条件下的诊断稳定性；摘要未说明样本稀缺的具体程度。
deep_read.method: 方法采用带物理启发残差正则化的多尺度卷积与双向门控循环单元，并以条件通道—空间Wasserstein生成对抗网络扩充故障样本。随后引入新损失函数和增强强化学习算法，动态调整残差正则项权重。[摘要]各模块结构及训练流程尚未披露。
deep_read.innovation: 摘要将组合方法称为“novel”，并提出新的损失函数与增强强化学习算法。[摘要]解读：值得核查的创新点在于让物理启发正则约束的强度动态变化，而非仅叠加诊断与生成模块；但没有公式及相关工作比较，无法确认其独创程度。
deep_read.findings: 实验结论限于所评估的轴承故障数据集：准确性达到“competitive diagnostic accuracy”，相较若干代表性先进深度学习方法，诊断表现相对稳定。[摘要]这些是定性报告，不能改写为全面领先，也无法据此判断增益大小或统计显著性。
deep_read.limitations: 摘要没有提供数据集名称、标注样本量、评价指标数值、对比方法清单及消融结果，因此难以分离各模块贡献。[摘要]解读：这些属于当前资料的证据缺口，并不等于论文未开展相关实验；物理残差的依据及生成样本可信度也需全文核验。
deep_read.connection: 解读：该研究直接对应智能运维中的少标注故障识别，可为可靠性研究提供状态诊断层面的候选方法，但摘要未涉及寿命预测、失效概率或结构设计优化。[摘要]其“physics-inspired”表述也不足以证明模型严格满足明确的机械控制方程。
deep_read.next_steps: 建议：获取全文后优先核查残差定义、强化学习的状态与奖励、生成数据的训练边界，并检查不同标注比例下的消融和重复实验。若迁移到自有设备，可分别验证增强模块与动态权重机制的贡献；这些是后续研究建议，并非作者已报告的结果。

article.lead: 轴承故障诊断面临的难点，不只是识别故障，还包括标注数据稀缺时能否保持可靠表现。这项研究将物理启发正则化、生成式数据增强与强化学习结合，探索兼顾诊断准确性与稳定性的方法。

sections.title: 标注不足，影响的不只是诊断准确率
paragraphs: 机械故障识别关系到工业系统的稳定运行，但实际应用中的故障标注数据不足，会削弱诊断方法的准确性与泛化能力。本文针对这一问题提出MPINN-ERL，即结合增强强化学习的多尺度物理信息神经网络，研究对象是数据稀缺条件下的轴承故障诊断。

sections.title: 把残差约束、样本增强与权重调节结合起来
paragraphs: 诊断模型采用多尺度卷积与双向门控循环单元，并加入物理启发残差正则化模块，将动态残差正则化融入系统。这里应保留“物理启发”的限定：摘要没有给出残差的具体公式，也未说明它对应哪些轴承动力学关系，不能据此将其理解为完整物理方程的直接求解。
针对样本不足，研究设计了条件通道—空间Wasserstein生成对抗网络，用于生成增强故障样本。此外，作者引入损失函数与增强强化学习算法，动态调整物理启发动态残差正则化的权重。方法设计因此同时涉及数据增强与约束权重调节，而不只是增加网络结构。

sections.title: 摘要报告了有竞争力的准确性与相对稳定性
paragraphs: 摘要报告，在所评估的轴承故障数据集上，MPINN-ERL取得了有竞争力的诊断准确性；与若干具有代表性的先进深度学习方法相比，其诊断表现也相对稳定。**这一结论限于已评估的数据集与比较范围**，摘要没有提供具体准确率、提升幅度或稳定性指标，因此不宜进一步写成全面领先或已验证的工业部署效果。

sections.title: 样本规模、比较条件与验证边界仍待查阅
paragraphs: 仅凭摘要，尚无法判断数据集名称、真实标注样本数量、故障类别、训练测试划分，以及生成增强样本的数量和质量。增强样本不能直接视为新增的独立实测样本。比较方法的具体名单、调参条件、稳定性的衡量方式，以及是否包含跨工况或现场验证，也需要进一步查阅正文；这些属于摘要未报告的信息，并不意味着论文没有开展相关工作。

sections.title: 阅读启发：关注物理约束如何参与诊断
paragraphs: 阅读启发：对智能运维读者，这项工作的关注点不仅是故障样本如何扩充，还在于物理启发约束如何进入模型，以及其权重为何需要动态调整。进一步阅读时，可重点核对残差的物理含义、强化学习的调节机制，以及各组成部分对最终表现的贡献证据，再判断这一组合是否适用于自身的数据稀缺场景。

paragraphs: 摘要报告，在所评估的轴承故障数据集上，MPINN-ERL取得了有竞争力的诊断准确性；与若干具有代表性的先进深度学习方法相比，其诊断表现也相对稳定。**这一结论限于已评估的数据集与比较范围**，摘要没有提供具体准确率、提升幅度或稳定性指标，因此不宜进一步写成全面领先或已验证的工业部署效果。

sections.title: 样本规模、比较条件与验证边界仍待查阅
paragraphs: 仅凭摘要，尚无法判断数据集名称、真实标注样本数量、故障类别、训练测试划分，以及生成增强样本的数量和质量。增强样本不能直接视为新增的独立实测样本。比较方法的具体名单、调参条件、稳定性的衡量方式，以及是否包含跨工况或现场验证，也需要进一步查阅正文；这些属于摘要未报告的信息，并不意味着论文没有开展相关工作。

sections.title: 阅读启发：关注物理约束如何参与诊断
paragraphs: 阅读启发：对智能运维读者，这项工作的关注点不仅是故障样本如何扩充，还在于物理启发约束如何进入模型，以及其权重为何需要动态调整。进一步阅读时，可重点核对残差的物理含义、强化学习的调节机制，以及各组成部分对最终表现的贡献证据，再判断这一组合是否适用于自身的数据稀缺场景。

papers.title: Machine-learning ultrasonic detection of fatigue cracks: a physics-based simulation study
papers.abstract: Fatigue cracks in microtextured titanium alloys are hard to find by ultrasound. Backscatter from alpha colonies, modulated by microtextured regions, mimics a small flaw, and crack faces held in contact by residual stress reflect far less energy than their area suggests. This paper is a simulation study. It builds a forward model of pulse-echo inspection whose constants are those of mill-annealed Ti-6Al-4V, verified against closed-form solutions on 15 quantities, and uses it to characterise what a learned detector can and cannot deliver under that model. The model solves a bilinear contact law at the crack interface, coupling the linear and nonlinear scattering paths. The detector reads the drive and second-harmonic bands through a small dilated residual encoder trained on simulated records only, and converts the score into a decision by split conformal calibration, whose false-call guarantee holds under exchangeability and is not claimed under distribution shift. On simulated test specimens with crack half-lengths from 0.05 to 1.0 mm, the encoder calls 73 of 84 low-contact cracks with no false call on 180 defect-free specimens (95% upper bound 0.017), and its fitted half-length at 90% detection is 0.138 mm (bootstrap interval 0.088–0.181 mm). A second-harmonic peak with no learning has the highest part-level area under the curve, the four leading methods are not separable on that measure, and an input ablation shows that an encoder reading the second-harmonic envelope alone matches or exceeds the full model, so the harmonic band carries the performance; over five training seeds the low-contact detection count spans 73 to 82 of 84. The encoder adds decision efficiency at the operating point, nine additional low-contact detections against one lost relative to the harmonic peak (paired test p = 0.02 ), not information absent from the measurement. Detection is confined to contact fractions between 0.05 and 0.30. The decision layer alone is then applied, as a methodological case study, to measured guided-wave data from an aluminium plate cycled to 100,000 cycles, where the second-harmonic channel gives 4 false calls in 370 angle tests and the drive band 9. No experimental validation on Ti-6Al-4V or on any other titanium alloy is presented, the only measured data are aluminium, and no qualification is claimed.

papers.title: Functional Tree Forest: A Hybrid Bagging-Boosting Ensemble Machine Learning Approach for Battery Fault Diagnosis in Electric Vehicles
papers.abstract: Accurate battery fault detection and diagnosis (FDD) is essential for ensuring the safety, health monitoring, and operational performance of electric vehicles (EVs). Yet, existing research still suffers from issues such as limited classification accuracy due to non-linear feature interactions and insufficient interpretability. To address these limitations, this study proposes the Functional Tree Forest (FTF), a hybrid Bagging-Boosting ensemble machine learning approach that combines multiple functional trees with LogitBoost-based modeling, while preserving model explainability. Unlike conventional decision trees that rely solely on axis-aligned univariate attribute splits, the FTF architecture dynamically integrates multivariate linear regression functions at both internal nodes and terminal leaf nodes, capturing complex feature interactions. The proposed method was evaluated on five publicly available EV battery fault datasets. The experimental results showed that FTF achieved top numerical accuracy across 13 baseline machine learning approaches, including linear models, conventional tree-based classifiers, ensembles, and network-based topologies. Furthermore, when compared with results directly given in the state-of-the-art studies utilizing identical datasets under varying experimental protocols, FTF yielded competitive performance relative to previously reported literature, although the magnitude of the performance difference varied across datasets.

papers.title: Comparative Study of Machine Learning Algorithms for Fault Diagnosis in PV Systems Specifically Under Low Irradiance Conditions
papers.abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) systems continue to expand worldwide, and reliable fault diagnosis has become increasingly important for ensuring safe and stable operation. Although machine-learning-based fault diagnosis has been widely investigated, most previous studies have focused on high-irradiance environments. In contrast, the effectiveness of fault diagnosis under low-irradiance conditions remains insufficiently explored. This study investigates the applicability of machine learning algorithms for diagnosing partial-shading faults in PV systems operating under low-irradiance conditions. An outdoor experimental PV system was used to simulate fault conditions, and current-voltage (I-V) characteristics were collected under various operating conditions. Prior to model development, outlier detection and data preprocessing were performed to improve data quality. Several supervised machine learning algorithms were trained and evaluated using commonly adopted classification metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The results indicate that fault diagnosis becomes more challenging under low-irradiance conditions because the differences between normal and faulty operating states become less distinct. Consequently, the performance of all evaluated algorithms tended to decrease compared with that observed under conventional irradiance conditions. Nevertheless, reliable fault detection remained feasible. Among the investigated methods, ensemble learning approaches demonstrated superior and more robust performance than conventional classification algorithms. These findings confirm the feasibility of machine-learning-based fault diagnosis for PV systems operating under low-irradiance conditions and highlight the potential of ensemble learning techniques for practical fault detection in regions with limited solar irradiance.

papers.title: Generative design and computational characterization of pyrazoline-based EGFR kinase inhibitor candidates.
papers.abstract: The epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) is an established therapeutic target in breast, colorectal, and non-small cell lung cancers, and pyrazoline-containing scaffolds have been repeatedly reported as EGFR inhibitors. This study combined generative machine learning with physics-based modelling to design and computationally characterize novel pyrazoline analogues targeting the EGFR kinase ATP-binding site. A curated set of 50 experimentally validated pyrazoline-based EGFR inhibitors, compiled from ChEMBL and the primary literature, was used to seed the Mol2Mol model in REINVENT4, generating a large library of structurally related analogues. The library was sequentially filtered according to Tanimoto similarity to the seed actives (≥0.6), predicted physicochemical, pharmacokinetic, and toxicity properties, synthetic accessibility (SA score <6), and molecular docking against the EGFR kinase domain (PDB 5U8L), using a self-docking validated protocol (redocking RMSD 1.342 Å). Five candidates, designated PyEG1-PyEG5, achieved docking scores between -9.5 and -10.6 kcal/mol, better than the redocked native ligand (-9.2 kcal/mol). All five complexes remained stable during 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations, with backbone RMSD ≤ 0.27 nm, average ligand RMSD ≤ 0.18 nm, and radii of gyration close to those of the reference complex. MM-GBSA end-point calculations yielded binding free energies of -9.9 to -37.5 kcal/mol, with PyEG5 (-37.5 ± 2.5 kcal/mol) approaching the reference ligand value (-37.6 ± 6.0 kcal/mol). Density functional theory calculations (B3LYP/6-31G(d)) indicated HOMO-LUMO gaps of 5.89-6.65 eV, with PyEG2 and PyEG5 predicted to be the most reactive and PyEG3 the most kinetically stable. Structure-activity analysis based on the predicted binding modes suggests that hinge-directed hydrogen bonding to Met793 and π-π stacking with Phe856 are the principal determinants of predicted affinity, modulated by substituent electronics and steric bulk at the R, R1, and R2 positions. These findings are entirely computational; PyEG1-PyEG5 should be considered prioritized synthetic targets, and their activity requires confirmation through biochemical kinase assays and cell-based testing.
